text:
Vikram: Heads up — during the scheduled GPU backfill at ~2026-03-17T09:04Z we saw intermittent small bursts of packet loss between gpu-pool-east nodes -> gpu-pool-west. GRPC streams had 200–600ms latency spikes and some retries. Not constant, roughly 1–3 bursts/min lasting ~20–40s. Anyone else seeing this?

Alana: saw traces matching that window. starting pcaps on node-12 and node-22. tagging @ops-oncall. initial thought: overlay reassembly + qdisc bounce under high-fanout.

ops-oncall: ack — cordoning node-22 while we investigate, pulling NIC stats and flow logs.

Tara: quick checks from node-12 -> node-22:

```
$ ping -c 100 10.3.22.11
--- 10.3.22.11 ping statistics ---
100 packets transmitted, 99 received, 1% packet loss, time 10001ms
rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 0.32/1.24/12.6/1.89 ms

$ ip -s link show geneve0
4: geneve0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1450 qdisc noqueue state UNKNOWN mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    RX: bytes  packets  errors  dropped  overrun mcast
    1234567  9876     0       12       0       0
    TX: bytes  packets  errors  dropped  carrier collsns
    2345678  12345    0       8        0       0
```

Vikram: tcpdump snippet on node-12 during spike:

```
12:09:04.123456 IP 10.3.12.2.50000 > 10.3.22.11.443: Flags [.], seq 12345:12405, ack 54321, win 6379, length 60
12:09:04.125000 IP 10.3.12.2.50000 > 10.3.22.11.443: Flags [R], seq 12405, ack 54321, win 0, length 0
# bursts of retransmits and duplicate ACKs after
```

sre-bot: alert: overlay-drop-rate gpu-pool-east > 0.8% for last 2m on node-12,node-22

Alana: hypothesis: backfill spray creates microbursty east-west flows. Geneve TX queue + GSO/GRO interactions on mlx5 might drop mid-stack under large aggregates. Plan: capture ethtool -S, temporarily disable GRO on geneve0 for a node pair, run a synthetic backfill canary.

ops-oncall: executing:

```
# disable GRO on geneve device
sudo ethtool -K geneve0 gro off
# collect driver stats
sudo ethtool -S ens5f0 | grep -E "tx_queue|rx_drop|gso"
```

Tara: after disabling GRO on node-12 and re-running a limited backfill, observed next 10m window: packet loss down to 0.2% and far fewer GRPC retries. Looks promising. will apply to node-22 next.

Vikram: nice isolate. Let's formalize mitigation: disable GRO for backfill windows + stagger fanout; capture artifacts; open JIRA for root cause (mlx5 offload + geneve MTU/qdisc interactions).

Alana: checklist & artifacts:
- pcaps: s3://redwood-incidents/2026-03/gpu-backfill-1767001234-pcaps.tar.gz
- ethtool stats + tcpdump snippets uploaded
- temp mitigation: operator script to set ethtool -K geneve0 gro off during backfills

ops-oncall: rolling operator script to canary group now. monitoring dashboards for overlay_drop_rate and GRPC error spikes. ping if it pops up in other regions.

Vikram: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll draft a short postmortem and schedule follow-up after 48h canary run.
